item.title: American democracy was a big winner in the midterms
item.description: Results are still outstanding House and Senate races but political scientists say one of the big winners in the mid-terms is American democracy itself.
item.content:encoded: Results are still outstanding House and Senate races but political scientists say one of the big winners in the mid-terms is American democracy itself.
item.dc:creator: Frank Langfitt

item.title: What to know about Gina Hinojosa, Texas' first Latina governor-elect
item.description: Gina Hinojosa, state representative from the Rio Grande Valley whose legislative priority has been boosting the public education system, will become the first Latina governor of Texas.
item.content:encoded: Gina Hinojosa, state representative from the Rio Grande Valley whose legislative priority has been boosting the public education system, will become the first Latina governor of Texas.
item.dc:creator: Blaise Gainey

item.title: Stephen Miller replaces Susie Wiles as White House chief of staff
item.description: White House chief of staff Susie Wiles is being replaced by Stephen Miller, President Trump said Friday. The change comes after Republicans were swept out of power in the midterm elections.
item.content:encoded: White House chief of staff Susie Wiles is being replaced by Stephen Miller, President Trump said Friday. The change comes after Republicans were swept out of power in the midterm elections.
item.dc:creator: Danielle Kurtzleben

item.title: The economy propelled Democrats to victory. What can they actually do about it?
item.description: Democrats' resounding victory in the midterms can be boiled down to frustrations over the high cost of living and gas prices. But in divided government -- how much can Democrats do?
item.content:encoded: Democrats' resounding victory in the midterms can be boiled down to frustrations over the high cost of living and gas prices. But in divided government -- how much can Democrats do?
item.dc:creator: Barbara Sprunt

item.title: The incoming class of U.S. senators is full of historic firsts
item.description: From the first Native American woman elected to the U.S. Senate and the first Muslim who will join the upper chamber to the Senate's first Paralympian, voters elected historic candidates on Tuesday.
item.content:encoded:
From the first Native American woman elected to the U.S. Senate and the first Muslim who will join the upper chamber to the Senate's first Paralympian, voters elected historic candidates on Tuesday.

item.title: No one knows how many ballots are outstanding in Mississippi's Senate race
item.description: The razor-thin margin between GOP Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith and Democrat Scott Colom is shining a light on an election process in Mississippi that is among the slowest and most decentralized in the U.S.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Judge halts construction of Trump's arch. And, Labor Department to release jobs report
item.description: A judge has blocked construction of Trump's arch moments after it won federal approval to proceed. And, the Labor Department is set to release the latest jobs report today, a day after stocks plunged.

item.title: 'He's got to go': Hakeem Jeffries calls for Hegseth's removal but stops short of impeachment
item.description: Speaking with Morning Edition, Hakeem Jeffries discussed ending the Iran war, holding Trump accountable and calls for new Democratic leadership, but offered few specifics on how Democrats would deliver.
